figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Phylogenetic tree of CYPs from different families. The tree was constructed based on amino acid sequences of CYPs. The bootstrap value
was set as 1000 replications. CYPs clustered in different CYP families are distinguished by different text colors, and CYPs from the four species in
our study are marked with different background colors: yellow for T. wilfordii, pink for T. regelii, blue for T. hypoglaucum, and green for C.
orbiculatus.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. UPLC/Q-TOF-MS analysis of extracts from yeast cultures. (A) Chromatograms (473.36 m/z) of the product (peak a) generated from
yeast harboring TwCYP716C52, TrCYP716C52, or ThCYP716C52 and the catalytic process of these three CYPs. (B) Chromatograms of the
products generated from yeast supplemented with the substrate 29-hydroxy-friedelin. Peak a, wilforic acid C (473.36 m/z); peak b, polpunonic acid
(457.36 m/z); and peak c, 29-hydroxy-friedelin (443.39 m/z). (C) Mass fragmentation spectra of the product (peak a). (D) Proposed biosynthetic
steps sequentially catalyzed by TwCYP712K1 and TwCYP716C52.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Analysis of the potential biological function of TwCYP716C52 in celastrol biosynthesis. (A) Construction of the RNAi-TwCYP716C52
vector. (B) Transformation of the RNAi vector into T. wilfordii suspension cells via the gene gun genetic transformation system, followed by RNA
extraction and chemical analysis. (C) Agarose gel electrophoresis of the Egfp fragment (799 bp) amplified by specific primers. (D) Relative
expression level of TwCYP716C52 and the content of celastrol in suspension cells of the RNAi group compared with the control group (*P < 0.05).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Comparison of relative yields of wilforic acid C produced by wild-type TwCYP716C52 (WT) and its mutants (n = 3). (A) Alanine scan
mutation analysis of 15 amino acids. (B) Yield comparison of the five amino acid mutants (H110, F118, Y119, G292, and A296). (C) Yield
comparison of mutants of the remaining 10 functional-retained amino acids and display of modeled binding mode of the three important amino
acid residues (Q141, L144, and I221) and polpunonic acid within TwCYP716C52 (**P < 0.01).
